title: Olon Menu Configuration
description: Navigation menus, keyed by menu name. `main` is the default; additional named menus (footer, sidebar, …) sit alongside.

main.description: The default top-level menu. Conventionally the primary navigation.

MenuItem.description: A single navigation entry. Items may nest recursively via `children`.

children.description: Sub-items rendered as a nested menu. Recursive; depth is not limited by the contract.

external.description: When true, the link points outside the current site and should typically open in a new tab.

href.description: Target URL. Accepts absolute (https://…), root-relative (/path), anchor (#id), mailto: and tel: schemes.

icon.description: An icon slug from the theme's icon set (e.g. `arrow-right`), or an absolute URL to a custom asset. SVG is preferred for resolution independence.

id.description: Stable identifier for this menu entry. Must be unique within its parent list when present. Optional in source data; the persistence layer assigns one if absent.

isCta.description: When true, this item is rendered with call-to-action emphasis rather than as a plain link.

label.description: Visible link text. Plain text, no markdown.
